name: research-scout
description: Deep-dive research and analysis of external reference materials against your current project. Analyzes videos, articles, repos, and docs — then cross-references findings with your codebase and delivers actionable recommendations.

output_dir.title: Report output directory
output_dir.description: Relative path where research reports are saved (e.g., docs/research or research)

backlog_file.title: Backlog file path
backlog_file.description: Relative path to the backlog file for saving action items (e.g., todos/backlog.md). Leave empty to skip backlog integration.

use_git.title: Auto-commit with Git
use_git.description: Whether to auto-commit and push reports after saving (true/false)

git_branch.title: Git branch for research
git_branch.description: Branch to checkout and commit to when saving reports. Leave empty to use the current branch.

use_shelby.title: Save learnings to Shelby memory
use_shelby.description: Whether to save key research insights to project memory via Shelby MCP (true/false). Requires Shelby to be installed.
